put.summary: Updates a contract while preserving its work relationship
put.description: Lifecycle guards also apply here: completion requires all services terminal and eligible; cancellation requires CANCEL authorization and all services cancelled without live commitments. Prefer the dedicated status route to avoid profile snapshots. 202 is only a proposal; approval revalidates. A changed reference already used in the work returns 409 with reason CONTRACT_REFERENCE_ALREADY_EXISTS and a reference field violation.

put.summary: Changes only the contract status and optional completion date
put.description: Reads current profile under the contract lock; never requires client financial/profile snapshots. UPDATE authorization for completion/reopening, CANCEL for cancellation. Same lifecycle decisions as closure-eligibility; invalid transition gives409 with controlled reason. 202 stores only status intent, no official change; approval rereads current profile and revalidates. completedOn omitted/null preserves its current value, never automatically cleared or invented.

put.summary: Updates a service without changing its contract relationship
put.description: Completion requires exact proven financial settlement; cancellation requires CANCEL authorization and no live commitments, with reason codes matching closure-eligibility. Prefer the status-only route. Operational updates, including COMPLETED status, preserve the current service discount when discountType/discountValue are omitted or both null. Approval preserves the discount current at application time. An explicit equal pair is accepted as an echo; a different pair returns409 Problem Details with reason SERVICE_DISCOUNT_CHANGE_REQUIRES_DEDICATED_OPERATION. Use dedicated DISCOUNTS operations for changes/reversals. No implicit reversal, tenant from session, existing billing limits and approval apply.

put.summary: Changes only the contract service status
put.description: Reads current name, price, quantity and discounts under lock. UPDATE for completion/reactivation, CANCEL for cancellation. Completion requires exact proven settlement of the official commercial net value, including registered item withholding; credit/unknown legacy require reconciliation. No cascade or inferred receipt. 202 stores only status intent; approval preserves the profile current at application. Same controlled409 reasons as closure-eligibility.

put.summary: Applies or changes the discount of one contract service
put.description: New discount is blocked by an official open charge of this contract even without an invoice (CONTRACT_HAS_OPEN_CHARGES). Contract net must cover confirmed cash net of reversals (CONTRACT_NET_BELOW_RECEIVED_AMOUNT), plus all existing approved billing/base/discount commitments. Checks precede 202 and repeat at approval under locks; never count withholding or credit as cash.

put.summary: Applies or changes the contract-level adjustment without altering its services
put.description: CONTRACT_HAS_OPEN_CHARGES blocks discount while any non-cancelled official title has positive outstanding balance, even without an invoice; raw installment OPEN is not the source. CONTRACT_NET_BELOW_RECEIVED_AMOUNT protects confirmed cash net of reversals. Approved billing, origin capacity and discount commitments remain additional stricter limits. Validated before 202 and at approval under locks; no financial effect until applied.

get.summary: Lists historical receipts and reversals of one receivable
get.description: Requires only RECEIVABLES.READ, never BILLING.READ; tenant exclusively from session. Validates title/contract/company chain and exact original/reversal links, not shared service/name/date/amount. Includes cancelled entries and entries of cancelled/renegotiated titles by default. Original receipt is not rewritten when reversed. Signed persisted amounts and immutable contract currency; no notes, bank/fiscal data, allocation detail or audit payload. Empty valid title returns 200 empty page; missing/foreign title returns 404. No proposal 202 or financial/audit mutation. Balance remains /{receivableId}/balance; never sum locally or infer reversal permission. Default createdAt desc, id asc; nulls last.

parameters.name: entryType
parameters.description: Exact SETTLEMENT or REVERSAL; omitted includes both.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact persisted CONFIRMED or CANCELLED; omitted includes both. Reversed original may still be CONFIRMED.

parameters.name: paymentMethod
parameters.description: Exact persisted payment method, not a bank account or Pix key.

parameters.name: receivedFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive entry business date lower bound, ISO yyyy-MM-dd. Reversals use their reversal date.

parameters.name: receivedTo
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound; must not precede receivedFrom.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed: receivedOn, createdAt, entryType, paymentMethod, status. field,asc or field,desc; repeat for multiple fields. Default createdAt desc, id asc, nulls last.

200.description: Page of official historical receipts and reversals

post.summary: Records a partial or full receivable settlement
post.description: LEGACY COMMAND BLOCKED: generic receipts, direct or approval-only, return 409 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION with reason SETTLEMENT_INVOICE_LINK_REQUIRED. Use the distinct invoice-settlement-options/invoice-settlements flow with exact manual invoice-item links when available. This legacy operation creates no proposal, reservation or cash entry; old pending approvals remain blocked. Historical reads/reversals remain available. receivedOn must not exceed the official current UTC date; future dates return400 with a receivedOn violation. No runtime bypass or generic invoice-presence fallback.

202.description: Awaiting approval; no official financial change

post.summary: Reverses a settlement and reopens the receivable balance atomically

202.description: Awaiting approval; no official financial change

post.summary: Registers a manually allocated receipt with exact invoice-item origins
post.description: Requires RECEIVABLES CREATE authorization and INVOICES.READ. Only explicit manual values, positive canonical decimal strings; sum of lines equals amount. Same session tenant/contract/installment and exact composition; no automatic distribution. Revalidates title, invoice and item capacities and UTC date under ordered transactional locks. operationId is tenant-scoped idempotency; different payload gives409, repeat gives same receipt/proposal. 202 creates only one pending proposal and no financial reservation. Approval revalidates. Legacy generic receipts remain blocked; no external bank movement, fiscal replacement or invented historical attribution.

200.description: Replay of the same official receipt

get.summary: Lists official tenant payables
get.description: Requires PAYABLES.READ. Includes manual and tax titles, including cancelled history; pending requests never appear. Exact optional filters: financialScope, workId, contractId, supplierId, financialCategoryId, financialGroupId, currency, status. reference is a case-insensitive literal fragment; dueFrom/dueTo are inclusive. page >=0 (default 0); size 1..100 (default 20). Sort whitelist: dueOn, issuedOn, reference, originalAmount, createdAt, updatedAt; default dueOn asc, ties id asc. No companyId input, unscoped totals or implicit currency conversion. GET never changes status.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Filters persisted statuses before pagination and combines with status and other filters. OUTSTANDING: OPEN, OVERDUE and PARTIALLY_PAID, including titles with unavailable balances. HISTORY: PAID, CANCELLED, RENEGOTIATED and DRAFT. Omit to include all statuses.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed: dueOn,issuedOn,reference,originalAmount,createdAt,updatedAt followed by ,asc or ,desc; repeat for multiple fields.

post.summary: Creates individual payable titles in one financial group
post.description: Requires PAYABLES.CREATE authority: direct or REQUEST_CREATE+APPROVE; request-only returns 202 without official effects. operationId is tenant-scoped and idempotent for normalized identical payloads; different data returns 409. All titles share scope, links and immutable currency; each explicit amount/due date is preserved, without automatic division. Active supplier/category are optional. Approval revalidates their activation and tenant/contract chain atomically. No payments or external money transfer.

202.description: Pending approval only; replay reuses the pending request

get.summary: Lists recorded payments and reversals for one payable
get.description: Requires PAYABLES.READ. Ordered by effective date descending, recording time descending, then ID descending. page starts at 0; size is 1..100.

post.summary: Records an already made payment

200.description: Identical replay of an applied payment

202.description: Approval request only, without official payment or balance change

post.summary: Reverses an official payment in full
post.description: Requires PAYABLES.READ and CANCEL authority. Creates a signed linked reversal; the original remains immutable. operationId is idempotent within the company.

200.description: Identical replay of an applied reversal

202.description: Approval request only, without official reversal or balance change

post.summary: Explicitly reveals official or pending payment instructions
post.description: PAYABLES.READ + PAYABLES.VIEW_PAYMENT_DETAILS. Optional changeRequestId must be a pending instruction proposal for this title/tenant; only requester or PAYABLES.APPROVE reader may inspect it. Audited without secrets; Cache-Control no-store. Missing official instructions or foreign proposal returns 404. No bank/beneficiary validation.

get.summary: Downloads the private boleto PDF
get.description: PAYABLES.READ + VIEW_PAYMENT_DETAILS. Authenticated stream, audit VIEW_SENSITIVE, no-store, no public URL. Optional changeRequestId has the same requester/approver gates as reveal; no official PDF returns 404. Fixed safe filename boleto.pdf.

post.summary: Attaches a private boleto PDF to official BOLETO instructions
post.description: Requires READ + VIEW_PAYMENT_DETAILS + UPDATE authority. Save title and official BOLETO instruction first. Multipart file + instruction expectedVersion, optional justification<=1000. PDF 1 byte..10 MiB, .pdf/application/pdf, readable, unencrypted, at least one page; structural validation is not bank authenticity or malware scanning. Encrypted private storage. New immutable revision; 202 changes no official data and remains private to the pending proposal. No financial effect.

get.summary: Lists official invoices including cancelled history
get.description: Requires INVOICES.READ. Tenant exclusively from session. Documentary status remains separate from receiptPosition. Receipt amounts require additional RECEIVABLES.READ and exact invoice-item ownership; the manual ledger supplies confirmed cash net of exact reversals. Unknown legacy ownership/credits/renegotiations remain unavailable with null amounts, never inferred from contract cash. Literal business filters, no fiscal key/document search. Default issuedOn desc, id asc; nulls last. No writes.

post.summary: Registers an invoice for one contract using complete billed services
post.description: Every selected service in a charge must include ALL its exact active base/composition allocation origins at their full frozen commercial amounts, before withholding. NF may cover complete groups from several charges of the SAME contract. Partial legacy requires review; no rewriting history or restriction of partial cash receipts. Direct creation and approval revalidate the same rule under contract lock;202 has no coverage/capacity effect.400 for malformed input;409 Problem Details reasons include INVOICE_SERVICE_GROUP_INCOMPLETE, INVOICE_SERVICE_GROUP_ALREADY_DOCUMENTED, INVOICE_SERVICE_GROUP_LEGACY_PARTIAL, INVOICE_SERVICE_GROUP_REVIEW_REQUIRED and INVOICE_FISCAL_IDENTITY_ALREADY_REGISTERED.

202.description: Awaiting approval; no official financial change

get.summary: Lists official historical taxes of an invoice in the authenticated company
get.description: Requires INVOICES.READ, never inferred from create authority. Tenant comes exclusively from the session; validates invoice/contract/tax and linked receivable chain. Existing invoice without taxes returns an empty page; missing/foreign invoice returns 404. Includes REGISTERED and CANCELLED by default, including cancelled invoices. No receivable/payable IDs, details or balances are disclosed. GET never creates a tax/payable, reapplies withholding, changes financial state or writes financial audit. Default createdAt desc, id asc; no-store.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional exact persisted status: REGISTERED or CANCELLED. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: treatment
parameters.description: Optional exact treatment: PAYABLE_BY_COMPANY, WITHHELD_BY_CUSTOMER or INFORMATIONAL.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed non-null fields: createdAt, name, treatment, status. field,asc or field,desc; repeat for multiple fields. Ties id asc.

post.summary: Records a payable, withheld, or informational invoice tax

202.description: Awaiting approval; no official financial change

post.summary: Previews explicit-value or user-provided base/rate arithmetic without recording tax
post.description: Effective INVOICES.CREATE/request authority and tenant. Registered invoice only. Does not infer invoice total as base or select incidence, rate, regime, treatment or due date. HALF_UP to two decimals after exact base*rate/100, rate up to four decimal places. No writes, tax, withholding, payable or audit of creation; no-store.

post.summary: Records a reviewed tax calculation idempotently with the existing tax treatment rules
post.description: Effective INVOICES.CREATE/request authority and tenant. operationId scopes one immutable intent; same body replays 200 or pending 202, changed input/decided proposal conflicts 409. confirmedAmount must match official arithmetic. Registered invoice, receivable capacity and treatment/due date revalidated under existing locks, also at approval. 202 changes no official tax/withholding/payable. Legacy explicit amount POST unchanged. Does not create payment or cash receipt.

post.summary: Cancels an invoice, its items and tax effects atomically
post.description: Internal documentary cancellation; does not cancel the debt or reverse money. Revalidates before proposal and approval. 409 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION reasons: INVOICE_CANCELLATION_HAS_ACTIVE_RECEIPTS, INVOICE_CANCELLATION_HAS_TAX_PAYMENTS or INVOICE_CANCELLATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW. Shared titles with active receipts are conservatively blocked; no inferred invoice attribution. 202 preserves all official invoice, tax and financial state until approval.

202.description: Awaiting approval; no official financial change

get.summary: Lists historical invoice attachment metadata in the authenticated company
get.description: Requires INVOICES.READ. Missing/foreign invoice returns 404; existing invoice without attachments returns an empty page. Includes cancelled invoice history; no financial or audit changes. No storage access, public URL or fiscal contents. Default createdAt desc, id asc; Cache-Control no-store.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed: createdAt, attachmentType, originalFilename, contentSize; field,asc or field,desc. Repeat for multiple fields. Ties id asc; all sortable metadata fields are non-null.

post.summary: Uploads the PDF attachment for an invoice
post.description: Requires direct INVOICES.CREATE authority in the authenticated tenant. Accepts one PDF per invoice. Maximum 10 MiB; the .pdf extension and application/pdf MIME must match. PDF must parse, contain pages and not be encrypted. An existing PDF returns 409 INVOICE_PDF_ALREADY_ATTACHED. XML or incompatible file media returns 415 INVOICE_ATTACHMENT_PDF_REQUIRED. Legacy XML remains readable.

post.summary: Previews an issued national NFSe XML without financial effects
post.description: Requires INVOICES.READ and invoice creation authority; optional initial billingInstallmentId additionally requires BILLING.READ and must share the selected contract/session tenant. Multipart file and contractId. Up to10MiB, .xml/application/xml or text/xml. Only declared national namespace/version1.01; secure bounded parsing, no DTD/XXE/XInclude/network. Does NOT validate XSD, signature, authenticity, current fiscal status or bank data. DPS fields remain separate from NF; no substitution/cancellation, inferred service matching, zero defaults or automatic taxes. Monetary/percentage values are strings with source paths. Retention is reported separately from amount payable/received; partial breakdown remains review. 200 even for REQUEST_APPROVAL creation authority: no ChangeRequest, invoice, tax, payable, attachment or capacity reservation. Human confirms official IDs/whole billed-service groups using existing invoice registration201/202 and separate authorized attachment/tax operations. No public URL; no-store. Blocking issues prohibit automatic use of prefill; this response is not fiscal authorization.

get.summary: Lists tenant expense classifications
get.description: Requires COSTS_EXPENSES.READ. Name is a literal case-insensitive fragment; optional type filter. Active defaults true; page >= 0; size 1..100 (default 20). Allowed sorts: name,createdAt,updatedAt; default name asc, ties id asc. Classification never selects WORK/COMPANY scope automatically.

post.summary: Creates category with COSTS_EXPENSES creation authority
post.description: Code is uppercased and unique within the tenant, including inactive history; code/type are immutable. A category does not create a payable or determine its financial scope.

get.summary: Lists employees in the authenticated company
get.description: Minimal operational projection without personal documents, PIS, phone, birth date, gender, ethnicity or compensation. It intentionally does not accept document or compensation filters, preventing sensitive values from entering URLs and operational logs. Requires EMPLOYEES.READ; the full profile is a separate endpoint.

InvoiceXmlFiscalFacts.description: Confirmed source facts with XML provenance. Omitted fields are unknown. No official tax, credit, expense or receipt is implied.

InvoiceXmlSourceValue.description: Source text and exact XML path; monetary values use canonical two-place decimals, percentages up to four places, never JSON numbers. No fiscal validity claim.

FinancialCategoryChangeResponse.description: In 202 category is null; only the proposal exists.

type.description: Immutable expense classification. Does not replace or infer WORK/COMPANY scope.

EmployeeResponse.description: Operational employee record, independent from system access.

photoUrl.description: Authenticated employee-photo download URL; null when no identification photo was registered

accountNumber.description: Complete account number. Stored encrypted and never returned.

accountCheckDigit.description: Optional account check digit. Stored encrypted and only revealed through the controlled payment-details action.

pixKey.description: Complete Pix key. Stored encrypted and only revealed through the controlled payment-details action.

pixReceiverName.description: Confirmed name of the Pix key holder. Required with a Pix key for a static BR Code Pix QR; never inferred from the employee profile.

pixReceiverCity.description: Confirmed city of the Pix key holder. Required with a Pix key for a static BR Code Pix QR; never inferred from the employee address.

EmployeePaymentAccountResponse.description: Encrypted employee bank or Pix reference. Complete account and Pix values are never returned.

primaryAddress.description: Marks this address as the employee's primary address

reference.description: Optional contract number, unique per work regardless of case and surrounding whitespace. Keeping the same number permits edits to legacy duplicates.

currency.description: Opcional; somente a moeda original é aceita. Moeda é imutável, inclusive em rascunho.

hasActiveContractDiscount.description: Authoritative boolean on GET /api/v1/company/contracts/{contractId}: an active commercial ContractDiscount exists in the session tenant, even when its calculated effect is zero. Measurement adjustments alone do not make it true. Null in list and mutation responses means not evaluated; refresh the contract detail. Does not grant reversal permission or bypass approval/concurrency validation.

completedOn.description: Optional business date. Omitted/null preserves the date current at application, including approval; never invented automatically.

sourceServiceTemplateId.description: Optional immutable source template. On update it must match the service's existing source template.

discountType.description: Optional on creation. On update, omitted/null pair preserves the current discount; an explicit pair may only echo the current values. Changes and reversals require dedicated discount operations.

discountValue.description: Paired with discountType. On update this cannot change the current discount; omitted/null pair preserves it at application time, including approval.

AccessUserResponse.description: Company system user and its assigned access roles

displayName.description: Full name of the employee explicitly linked to this user in the same company. Omitted when unavailable.

companyOwner.description: True only for the immutable initial owner of this company

DiaryPhotoUploadRequest.description: Multipart file upload to one exact item. Supply either activityId or occurrenceId.

receivedOn.description: Actual receipt business date, ISO yyyy-MM-dd. Must not exceed the current UTC calendar date from the official server Clock; not a scheduled payment or due date. Revalidated on direct application and approval. GET receivables/{receivableId}/balance returns maxReceivedOn.

maxReceivedOn.description: Maximum receivedOn at response time: current UTC calendar date from the official server Clock. Keep yyyy-MM-dd unchanged, without browser timezone conversion. POST and approval revalidate independently; this is not settlement eligibility or an amount reservation.

settlementCreationAvailable.description: False for the legacy generic /settlements command, which remains blocked. The explicit manual invoice-item flow uses /invoice-settlement-options and /invoice-settlements instead; this flag must never enable the legacy form. Historical reads and reversals remain available; a positive balance alone does not authorize a receipt.

settlementCreationBlockReason.description: Controlled reason for temporary receipt creation unavailability. Currently SETTLEMENT_INVOICE_LINK_REQUIRED. No invoice data, tax payload or free-form client content.

amount.description: Positive canonical decimal. The new titles must total exactly the current unpaid balance.

CreateInvoiceSettlementRequest.description: Manual receipt with exact invoice-item origins. No automatic distribution. A pending proposal never reserves capacity.

receivedOn.description: Actual business date, not later than the official current UTC date.

measurementContractCompositionId.description: Exact composition from options; null only when the allocation has no measurement origin.

PendingInvoiceSettlementResponse.description: Only a proposal; no receipt, invoice line, reservation or official balance is created.

PayableCreateRequest.description: Creates 1..100 individual titles atomically in one server-generated financial group. No automatic installments, division, payment or bank transfer. Tenant comes only from the session.

financialScope.description: Explicit required scope. WORK requires workId; optional contractId must belong to that work. COMPANY forbids both links. Category never determines scope.

currency.description: Contract currency when linked: omitted derives it, a different value returns 409. Otherwise optional, defaults BRL. Immutable; no conversion.

issuedOn.description: Optional issue date; never inferred from due date.

dueOn.description: Business date; past due dates are allowed, without automatic payment or status mutation.

originalAmount.description: Positive exact money, two decimal places, no numeric JSON, exponent, symbol or comma.

PayableBalanceResponse.description: Official position of one title, as of the UTC business date. Amounts are null when the available ledger cannot substantiate the title status.

PayableCreationResponse.description: 201 direct creation, 200 idempotent official replay, or 202 pending approval. In 202 payables and financialGroupId are null: no official title/group or balance is created.

PayableReferenceResponse.description: Minimal safe label; no document, address, bank or contact details.

PayableResponse.description: Official individual payable. No manual balance, settlement or calculated payment is invented. Reference labels are safe server projections from this tenant.

overdue.description: Derived as of today UTC for OPEN/PARTIALLY_PAID/OVERDUE. Does not write status during a GET.

version.description: Optimistic persistence version of the payable.

paidOn.description: Date the payment was made. Cannot be after the current UTC date.

reversalOfId.description: Original payment ID for a reversal.

reversedOn.description: Effective reversal date, from the original payment date through today UTC.

PayablePaymentInstructionRevealResponse.description: Sensitive explicit reveal. Never store in client persistence, application logs, telemetry, exports or public URLs.

currency.description: Moeda ISO imutável. Padrão BRL; medição vinculada deriva a moeda do contrato quando omitida. Sem conversão.

externalAcceptanceNotes.description: Required and nonblank when RECORD_EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE records externallyAccepted=false.

correctionItemIds.description: Optional active item identifiers from this version when an external rejection requests corrections.

unitQuantity.description: Required and positive for UNIT, where it drives unitQuantity × unitPrice. Optional for all other charge types as an operational count of executed pieces; in those types it does not affect the formula, weight or amount.

previewTotalWeightKg.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

previewTotalAmount.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

continuousServiceId.description: Stable continuous service of this measurement. Select the persisted ID to continue a service in later advances.

unitQuantity.description: Required and positive for a UNIT replacement, where it drives unitQuantity × unitPrice. Optional for other charge types as an operational count only; it does not affect their formula, weight or amount.

chargeType.description: UNIT requires unitQuantity and uses unitQuantity × unitPrice; it has no totalWeightKg.

unitQuantity.description: Required and positive for UNIT, where it drives unitQuantity × unitPrice. Optional for all other charge types as an operational count of executed pieces; in those types it does not affect the formula, weight or amount.

previewTotalWeightKg.description: Optional frontend preview. UNIT may omit it or send 0.0000.

previewTotalAmount.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

spreadsheetHash.description: SHA-256 returned by preview and required unchanged on confirmation.

documentTotalAmount.description: Confirmed documentary commercial amount before withholding. XML-assisted clients must send the reviewed commercialAmountCandidate; manual legacy clients may omit. Backend compares with whole selected service groups and revalidates approval; no frontend sum/rateio. Not a signature/source binding.

CalculateInvoiceTaxRequest.description: Arithmetic supplied by the user, not a fiscal engine. AMOUNT requires amount only; PERCENTAGE requires explicit baseAmount and ratePercent only. No inferred invoice base, rate, incidence, regime or treatment. Positive inputs; rate up to four decimal places; result HALF_UP to cents.

ratePercent.description: User-supplied positive percentage up to four decimal places; never inferred or rounded on entry. No assumed fiscal 100% cap.

InvoiceTaxCalculationResponse.description: Official arithmetic, not tax advice. Preview has no tax ID and recorded=false. Historical legacy explicit-value tax has its ID but recorded=false because no new calculation intent was stored.

confirmedAmount.description: Exactly the official amount reviewed in preview. Divergence is 400; never silently replaced.

CalculatedTaxObligationCreationResponse.description: 201 applied, 200 same-operation replay; 202 contains only changeRequestId and mode. Missing entities are omitted, never fictional objects. Original endpoints remain compatible.

InvoiceAttachmentResponse.description: Official attachment metadata only. No storage key, path, public URL or fiscal contents. All fields are non-null.

InvoiceXmlPreviewResponse.description: Stateless assisted XML preview; never an official invoice, fiscal validation, tax obligation, payment, attachment or reservation. All monetary source values are canonical decimal strings with provenance; absence is unavailable. Requires human review and official full-service coverage on subsequent manual registration.

EmployeePaymentDetailsResponse.description: Complete payment reference, returned only after an explicit, audited request authorized by EMPLOYEES.VIEW_PAYMENT_DETAILS. Do not cache, export or log these values.

accountNumber.description: Complete bank account number. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

accountCheckDigit.description: Complete account check digit. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

pixKey.description: Complete Pix key. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

pixCopyPaste.description: Static BR Code Pix copy-and-paste payload, with CRC. It has no amount, charge, due date or financial identifier. Null for legacy Pix references until the confirmed holder name and city are provided.

pixQrCode.description: PNG QR Code as a data URL for the static Pix payload. It has no amount, charge, due date or financial identifier. Null when pixCopyPaste is null.

reference.description: Optional contract number, unique per work regardless of case and surrounding whitespace. Letters, numbers and punctuation are preserved.

currency.description: Moeda ISO imutável. Padrão BRL; medição vinculada deriva a moeda do contrato quando omitida. Sem conversão.

AppliedEntityResponse.description: Record created or applied by an approved change request, when available

netBillingGrossAmount.description: Immutable gross basis consumed by net billing; null for legacy allocations.

netBillingDiscountAmount.description: Immutable contract discount applied by net billing; null for legacy allocations.

CreateNetBillingRequest.description: Positive net billing only. The backend allocates contract discount over uncommitted capacity; never send CONTRACT_DISCOUNT or a calculated gross amount.

capacityVersion.description: Version from GET net-capacity. Stale capacity produces 409; a pending proposal does not reserve it.

measurementContractCompositionId.description: Exact immutable measurement composition; omit only for negotiated base capacity.

CreateServiceNetBillingRequest.description: Bill services without selecting technical origins. Negotiated base first, then official acceptance date ascending; ties measurementId/versionId/compositionId lexicographically. Existing commitments never change. ALL_AVAILABLE consumes only usable capacity of the quoted version.

netAmount.description: Required positive amount for PARTIAL; must be absent/null for ALL_AVAILABLE.

PlatformChargeTrustUnlockResponse.description: Overdue platform charge and its trust unlock availability

ReceivableFinancialPositionResponse.description: Official current title position, same currency as the title. Cash is confirmedSettlementAmount net of reversals; credits and withholding are separate. No invoice attribution is inferred. CANCELLED/RENEGOTIATED are historical, not amounts to collect.

ReceivableSummaryResponse.description: Official title and current financialPosition, requiring RECEIVABLES.READ. originalAmount/status remain persisted face value/status. Financial totals are canonical and separate cash, credits, withholding and outstanding; no tax/settlement payload or measurement content. No cross-currency aggregation.

status.description: Persisted official status; never updated on GET. Use financialPosition for cash/adjustment position; dueOn remains a business date and this status is not a derived overdue indicator.

ReceivableDetailsResponse.description: Official title/context with the same financialPosition as the list. No individual settlements, tax payloads or invoice attribution. Settlement eligibility remains in the existing balance endpoint.

ReceivableSettlementHistoryResponse.description: Official historical cash entry, not a balance or permission to reverse. SETTLEMENT is positive; REVERSAL is negative. Original status is not rewritten after reversal; follow exact reversal IDs, never infer by amount/date/name. No note, bank/fiscal data, attribution contents or audit payload.

displayLabel.description: Controlled human label: Recebimento or Estorno de recebimento. Use with business date, payment method and createdAt for readable selection, id only as opaque selection key.

receivedOn.description: Business date of this entry: receipt date for SETTLEMENT, reversal date for REVERSAL.

amount.description: Persisted signed amount, positive receipt or negative reversal. Never absolute value, balance or frontend total.

reversalOfSettlementId.description: Exact original receipt of a reversal, same title/contract/tenant. Null on original receipts.

reversedBySettlementId.description: Exact existing reversal of an original receipt, even if filtered out of this page. Null when no reversal exists or this row is a reversal. Not an authorization flag.

status.description: Persisted CONFIRMED or CANCELLED. A reversed original may remain CONFIRMED; it is not relabelled or removed.

createdAt.description: Persisted UTC registration instant; distinguish from the business date. Not truncated to a date.

InvoiceSettlementOptionResponse.description: Exact selectable origin; limits overlap and cannot be added. Invoice and title limits are revalidated jointly for all manual lines; Registered customer withholding is allocated proportionally by exact gross invoice item, with deterministic cents. Net amounts are unavailable when title scope or historical attribution cannot be proven. Partial cash remains manual.

withheldItemAmount.description: Proportional registered customer withholding for this exact item; null when unproven.

netInvoicedItemAmount.description: Gross invoiced item less its withholding share; cash is not included.

netAvailableItemAmount.description: Net item less signed confirmed exact cash; still subject to shared invoice/title limits.

TotalInvoiceSettlementProposalResponse.description: Read-only proposal for the entire outstanding title balance using its exact documented billing origins. Uses exact remaining net item capacities after proportional customer withholding within one original title scope; deterministic cents, never FIFO or automatic partial cash distribution. Unknown scope or incompatible historical cash requires reconciliation. Independent of the options page. No reservation; POST and approval revalidate. Partial receipts remain manual.

externalAcceptanceNotes.description: Safe operational description of the corrections requested externally.

totalWeightKg.description: Null when this service contains only non-weighted lines.

InvoiceReceiptPositionResponse.description: Official receipt position, separate from documentary invoice.status. Exact manual invoice-item ledger determines cash, net of exact reversals; never infer cash from a shared contract/title. Requires RECEIVABLES.READ plus INVOICES.READ. Unknown legacy attribution, credits or renegotiation remain unavailable with null amounts. Existing invoice withholding affects only that invoice's net balance, without item distribution. SETTLED_BY_ADJUSTMENTS is not money received. The legacy generic receipt endpoint remains blocked.

receivedAmount.description: Exact confirmed cash net of linked reversals; null when unavailable.

outstandingAmount.description: Official invoice net amount less exact cash, including its own withholding; null when unavailable.

calculatedAt.description: UTC instant at which availability was evaluated, not a payment timestamp.

InvoiceSummaryResponse.description: Official invoice header, including cancelled history. Contract labels reflect its current safe identification. No fiscal access key or storage data.

InvoiceDetailsResponse.description: Official invoice, safe receipt availability and all historical items. Exact invoice receipt attribution is currently unavailable, never inferred from allocation or contract cash. No measurement content, fiscal key, attachments or tax payload.

measurementContractCompositionId.description: Exact persisted measurement composition origin; null for negotiated base or legacy contract discount. No measurement content is disclosed.

InvoiceTaxObligationResponse.description: Official persisted invoice tax, including cancelled history. No receivable/payable IDs, balances, payment state or fiscal access key. Currency is inherited from the invoice contract; GET never reapplies tax effects.

dueOn.description: Recorded due date, if any; mandatory on creation only for PAYABLE_BY_COMPANY.

InvoiceContractResponse.description: Minimal contract group represented by at least one official persisted invoice, including cancelled history. Current commercial labels, not fiscal snapshots. No amounts, balances, invoice counts or permission to read the full contract.

contractId.description: Stable internal navigation context. Select from this index; never match groups only by name.

EmployeeListItemResponse.description: Minimal operational employee list item. Does not include documents, PIS, phone, birth date, gender, ethnicity or compensation. The full profile has a separate response contract.

photoUrl.description: Authenticated photo endpoint; requires EMPLOYEES.READ and the same tenant

eligible.description: Null when financial READ permissions are missing; false is a known block, true permits requesting the indicated authorization mode.

reason.description: Controlled lifecycle or permission reason; null only when eligible. For a COMPLETED service, an authorized financial blocking reason takes precedence over SERVICE_ALREADY_COMPLETED; that historical-status reason is only a fallback when no financial block is available. No financial reason is resolved without the required READ permissions.

authorizationMode.description: DIRECT or REQUEST_APPROVAL; null when action authorization is missing.

ContractClosureEligibilityResponse.description: Read-only lifecycle decisions. Whole-contract summary precedes filtering/paging. CONTRACT_FINANCIAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED distinguishes unproven origin/credit history from CONTRACT_HAS_UNSETTLED_SERVICES; reconciliation takes precedence across services and does not mean missing cash. No financial amounts or receipt identifiers. A decision is not a reservation; PUT and approval revalidate.

ChangeRequestEntityResponse.description: Safe human-readable projection of the record involved in a change request

ChangeRequestRequesterResponse.description: Safe requester projection scoped to the authenticated company; no storage keys or public URLs are exposed

employeeId.description: Linked operational employee in the same company, when available

photoUrl.description: Authenticated employee-photo endpoint; null without a linked employee photo

coverage.description: RECORDED_MOVEMENTS covers official recorded entries only, with no assurance of complete bank history. NO_PERMISSION hides the amount and count.

companyPayments.description: Company-wide expenses. Omitted from the work view.

netMovement.description: Signed receipts minus signed payments. Null when either permission is missing.

cashResultPercentage.description: Work cash result divided by positive net recorded receipts, multiplied by 100. Null in the company view, when a source is unauthorized, or when net receipts are zero or negative.

from.description: Requested start date, or the first authorized movement in the accumulated view. Null if that view has no movements.

status.description: RECORDED_MOVEMENTS compares recorded movements only. INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS means one or both periods have no entries. NON_POSITIVE_BASE excludes percentage change.

percentageChange.description: Relative change as a percentage without a percent sign. Null for missing records or a non-positive previous total.

coverage.description: Scope of available evidence. Recorded entries do not certify the completeness of the period.

amount.description: Signed total of recorded payments and reversals. Zero with no entries does not prove historical coverage.

BillingInstallmentSummaryResponse.description: Official persisted installment, including cancellation history. netAmount is the signed sum of its allocations, not its remaining receivable balance.

status.description: Persisted business status, not the current receipt status. Status filters and sorting use this field; use receivableFinancialStatus for the financial badge when available.

receivableFinancialStatusAvailable.description: True only when RECEIVABLES.READ is granted in addition to BILLING.READ and the installment original receivable has an official financial position. False means unavailable, never OPEN or zero.

receivableFinancialStatus.description: Official current status of the ORIGINAL receivable linked to this installment, using confirmed cash net of reversals, withholding and credits. Settled by adjustments is not cash RECEIVED. Preserves cancelled/renegotiated originals, does not aggregate children or imply settlement of an individual service/allocation. Null without permission or without an original title; no NF/date/client inference, and 202 proposals have no effect.

receivableReceivedWithWithholding.description: Presentation hint from the same authorized original-title financial position: true only for SETTLED_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS with zero outstanding, positive confirmed cash net of reversals, positive withholding and zero credits. UI may show Received with tax withholding. Does not classify withholding as cash or change financial status/amounts. False for other available positions, including credits/mixed adjustments or no cash; null without permission or original title. No new receipt, query per line or client-side balance formula.

BillingInstallmentDetailsResponse.description: Read-only official installment. Origin UUIDs preserve financial traceability; no measurement content, invoice or settlement balance is disclosed. Authorized financial status refers exclusively to the original title.

status.description: Persisted business status, not the current receipt status; use receivableFinancialStatus when available.

receivableReferencesAvailable.description: True only with RECEIVABLES.READ. When false the list is empty because access is restricted, not because no titles exist.

receivableFinancialStatusAvailable.description: True only when RECEIVABLES.READ is granted in addition to BILLING.READ and the installment original receivable has an official financial position. False means unavailable, never OPEN or zero.

receivableFinancialStatus.description: Official current status of the ORIGINAL receivable linked to this installment, using confirmed cash net of reversals, withholding and credits. Null without permission or without an original title; no NF/date/client inference, and 202 proposals have no effect.

receivableReceivedWithWithholding.description: Presentation hint from the same authorized original-title financial position: true only for SETTLED_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS with zero outstanding, positive confirmed cash net of reversals, positive withholding and zero credits. UI may show Received with tax withholding. Does not classify withholding as cash or change financial status/amounts. False for other available positions, including credits/mixed adjustments or no cash; null without permission or original title. No new receipt, query per line or client-side balance formula.

contractReference.description: Official contract reference shown as the contract number in work billing.

receivedAmountAvailable.description: True only with effective RECEIVABLES.READ in addition to BILLING.READ. False means receivedAmount is unavailable, not zero.

receivedAmount.description: Official sum of signed CONFIRMED receipts and reversals of this contract in the authenticated company, including historical/renegotiated titles without double counting. Retentions, credits, NFs and 202 proposals are not cash. Null without RECEIVABLES.READ; authorized empty history returns 0.00. Never sum titles or versions in the frontend.

installmentStatus.description: Persisted installment business/historical status. Does not establish the current receipt position; use receivableFinancialStatus when available.

receivableFinancialStatusAvailable.description: True only when RECEIVABLES.READ is granted in addition to BILLING.READ and the installment original receivable has an official financial position. False means unavailable, never OPEN or zero.

receivableFinancialStatus.description: Official current status of the ORIGINAL receivable linked to this installment, using confirmed cash net of reversals, withholding and credits. Settled by adjustments is not cash RECEIVED. Preserves cancelled/renegotiated originals, does not aggregate children or imply settlement of an individual service/allocation. Repeated on allocations of the same installment. Null without permission or without an original title; no NF/date/client inference, and 202 proposals have no effect.

receivableReceivedWithWithholding.description: Presentation hint from the same authorized original-title financial position: true only for SETTLED_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS with zero outstanding, positive confirmed cash net of reversals, positive withholding and zero credits. UI may show Received with tax withholding. Does not classify withholding as cash or change financial status/amounts. False for other available positions, including credits/mixed adjustments or no cash; null without permission or original title. No new receipt, query per line or client-side balance formula.

activeCapacityAmount.description: Gross capacity already consumed; includes the frozen basis of net allocations.

netAvailableToBillAmount.description: Official net availability after proportional contract discount on uncommitted capacity; use net-capacity for exact origins.

receivedAmountAvailable.description: True only with effective RECEIVABLES.READ in addition to BILLING.READ. False means receivedAmount is unavailable, not zero.

receivedAmount.description: Official sum of signed CONFIRMED receipts and reversals of this contract in the authenticated company. Includes historical/renegotiated titles, without double counting. Not retention, credit, invoice value or a 202 proposal. Null without RECEIVABLES.READ; authorized empty history returns 0.00. This aggregate does not establish receipt eligibility or invoice coverage.

remainingNetAmount.description: Global uncommitted net ceiling; blocked origins remain in distribution but cannot be selected.

ServiceNetBillingCapacityResponse.description: Complete origin coverage per service, calculated before pagination. Page may contain only some services; never sum pages to compute capacity. All currently usable sources are covered, blocked capacity is separate.

BillableMeasurementOriginResponse.description: Applied accepted measurement composition eligible for billing. Destination IDs are immutable; amounts are per origin, not a reservation or a replacement for contract/service limits.

contractServiceId.description: Immutable destination recorded by this composition; never inferred from the current continuous-service destination.

status.description: Only applied, accepted, unreversed origins without unreconciled reductions and with positive remaining capacity are returned.

activeCapacityAmount.description: Gross origin capacity consumed, not only the net amount billed.

netAvailableToBillAmount.description: Official available net after the proportional uncommitted contract discount.

AuditEventResponse.description: Tenant-scoped audit event without before/after payloads

occurredAt.description: When the audited action occurred, always represented in UTC

actorUserId.description: Trusted actor identifier; null only for SYSTEM events

actorDisplayName.description: Safe, human-readable name for the audit timeline. Never contains an email address, UUID, or other technical identifier.

actorEmail.description: Actor contact email when available. This is separate from actorDisplayName and is null for SYSTEM or unavailable historical actors.

metadata.description: Only explicitly allow-listed, non-sensitive audit metadata
